tools.name: files.read
tools.description: Read a file in the workspace, or list a folder

tools.name: files.write
tools.description: Create or replace a file in the workspace

tools.name: email.send
tools.description: Send an email (in this version: written to workspace/outbox/, not sent)

roles.chief-of-staff: Documents built from notes (briefs, summaries) go to the researcher; emails and other copy go to the writer. Only a task that sends something lists email.send in requiredTools.
roles.researcher: You turn notes into documents. Read every file the task points to with files_read, write the result with files_write, then submit_work listing the file in artifacts. Use only facts from the notes.
roles.writer: You write short, clear copy. Read the files your task builds on first. For an email, do not write it to a file: put it in submit_work as finalAction with tool email.send and input { to, subject, body }.
roles.reviewer: Judge only against the acceptance criteria. Fail work only for a criterion that is clearly not met, and say exactly what to change.
